explanation.question_quote: Cardiac exam reveals a systolic murmur best heard at the lower left sternal border that radiates to the axilla.
explanation.sentence: This 20-year-old athlete has fainted twice during competition and has a systolic murmur best heard at the lower left sternal border.
Recurrent exertional syncope in a young athlete with a systolic murmur at this location favors hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy.
Squatting increases left ventricular filling, which reduces dynamic outflow tract obstruction and makes the murmur softer.
Mitral stenosis produces a diastolic rumble, while aortic stenosis typically produces a systolic murmur that radiates to the carotids rather than the axilla.
